authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §§7–9: R2013/2018 use R2004-family section organization, HEADER contains the optional 4-byte word and CRC after the data; CRC covers the size and data. The size-word convention below is grounded in both physical producer sections.

span_evidence: In both extracted pages the first 16 bytes are the HEADER begin sentinel; size is read at offset 16, high word at 20, CRC at 24+size, and the matching end sentinel directly follows. CRC16/0xc0c1 over bytes [16,826) matches. The pages contain bytes after the end sentinel; this check neither interprets them as padding nor claims a complete logical-section length.
implementation: For emitted AC1027/AC1032 HEADER only, count from after the optional high word; include the low size word and high word in CRC16. Adjust the final HANDSEED/current-reference reseal locator to the same boundary. Earlier versions retain their existing framing and no fixed-header 0x0b metadata is changed.
